nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: The study used Gaussian process regression (GPR) to estimate normative models for functional activation underlying emotional episodic memory. The implementation was done using the Predictive Clinical Neuroscience (PCN) toolkit (https://pcntoolkit.readthedocs.io).
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: We utilized Gaussian process regression to estimate normative models reflecting relevant functional activation underlying emotional episodic memory using the Predictive Clinical Neuroscience toolkit (https://pcntoolkit.readthedocs.io/en/ latest).
nm2_1_modeling_methods.location: Xiao2024.pdf.md: Methods and Materials / Normative Modeling and Estimating Individual Deviations

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Task-fMRI activation maps (aversive-neutral retrieval phase) for DK atlas regions were the response variables.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: First, the task activation maps were used as response variables, and predictive factors comprised task performances including RT in the encoding and retrieval phase and ACC in the retrieval phase.
nm2_2_response_variable.location: Xiao2024.pdf.md: Normative Modeling and Estimating Individual Deviations

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Task performance predictors: RT in encoding and retrieval phases; ACC in retrieval phase.
